# paperclip_agent (Data Source)

Reads Paperclip agent details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paperclip_agent" "engineer" {
  company_id = data.paperclip_company.acme.id
  name       = "Platform Engineer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company_id` (String) The Paperclip company ID.
- `id` (String) Agent unique identifier.
- `name` (String) Agent name.

### Read-Only

- `adapter_config` (String) JSON adapter configuration string.
- `adapter_type` (String) Adapter type.
- `authorization_policy` (String) JSON authorization policy for the agent.
- `can_assign_tasks` (Boolean) Whether the agent holds the task-assignment permission.
- `can_create_agents` (Boolean) Whether the agent may create other agents.
- `can_create_skills` (Boolean) Whether the agent may create skills.
- `capabilities` (String) Free-form description of agent capabilities.
- `default_environment_id` (String) Identifier of default environment.
- `icon` (String) Agent icon identifier.
- `instructions` (String) Managed AGENTS.md instructions for this agent.
- `metadata` (String) JSON metadata object.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the agent is currently paused.
- `reports_to` (String) Identifier of the agent's manager.
- `role` (String) Agent role.
- `runtime_config` (String) JSON runtime configuration string.
- `status` (String) Agent status.
- `title` (String) Agent title.
- `trust_preset` (String) Trust policy preset.
